book: BC exam drugs · EMR vs PCP
title: New PCP drugs: glucose, nausea and allergy
next: BC exam drugs, Lesson 3: New PCP drugs: breathing, steroids and TXA

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already treat low sugar with gel or glucagon, position the vomiting patient, and give epinephrine for anaphylaxis. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Give D10W: when, how much, and what to watch
  2. Choose between ondansetron and dimenhydrinate
  3. Place diphenhydramine correctly: after epinephrine, never instead

BC source: drug monographs pages 61, 63, 64, 75; protocols pages 48, 55, 57
slides.say: Welcome back. As an EMR, you already treat low blood sugar with glucose gel or glucagon, you position a vomiting patient to protect the airway, and you give epinephrine for anaphylaxis. Today we add four drugs that only a PCP can give. First, D10W, the IV sugar: when to give it, how much, and what can go wrong. Second, the two anti-nausea drugs, ondansetron and dimenhydrinate, and how to choose between them. Third, diphenhydramine, an antihistamine, and its exact place in anaphylaxis: after epinephrine, never instead of it.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。当 EMR 时，你已经会用葡萄糖凝胶或胰高血糖素处理低血糖，会给呕吐病人摆好体位保护气道，会给过敏性休克病人用肾上腺素。今天加四种只有 PCP 能给的药。第一，D10W，静脉用的糖：什么时候给、给多少、可能出什么问题。第二，两种止吐药，昂丹司琼和茶苯海明，以及怎么二选一。第三，苯海拉明，一种抗组胺药，它在过敏性休克里的准确位置：在肾上腺素之后，绝不能代替肾上腺素。

slides.title: Four new drugs, three protocols
slides.body:
DrugTypeProtocol
D10Wsugar (dextrose 10%)Diabetic emergencies
Ondansetronanti-nausea (5-HT3 blocker)Nausea–vomiting
Dimenhydrinateanti-nausea, antihistamineNausea–vomiting; cardiac chest pain
DiphenhydramineantihistamineAnaphylaxis

All four are PCP only; none appears in an all-levels list.
slides.say: Here's the map. D10W is dextrose, a sugar, and it lives in the diabetic emergencies protocol. Ondansetron and dimenhydrinate both treat nausea and live in the nausea and vomiting protocol, which BC labels PCP in its title. Dimenhydrinate also appears in cardiac chest pain, where nausea is common. Diphenhydramine is an antihistamine in the anaphylaxis protocol. All four are PCP only, so if a question asks whether an EMR may give any of them, the answer is no. Learn each drug together with its protocol, because that's how you'll meet it on a call.
slides.sayZh: 先看地图。D10W 是葡萄糖，一种糖，在糖尿病急症流程里。昂丹司琼和茶苯海明都止恶心，在恶心呕吐流程里，这个流程的标题里就标着 PCP。茶苯海明在心源性胸痛流程里也出现，因为那里常有恶心。苯海拉明是抗组胺药，在过敏性休克流程里。四种都是 PCP 专用，所以如果题目问 EMR 能不能给其中任何一种，答案是不能。每种药都和它的流程一起记，因为出车时你就是这样遇到它们的。

slides.title: D10W: sugar straight into the vein
slides.body:
10–25 g IV = 100–250 mL of 10% solution

  • D10W = 10 g of dextrose in every 100 mL
  • Indications: suspected or known hypoglycemia
  • Also: altered responsiveness; coma or seizure NYD
  • Onset: immediate. Contraindications: none
  • Caution: extravasation causes tissue necrosis
slides.say: D10W means dextrose ten percent in water: ten grams of sugar in every one hundred millilitres. The BC dose is ten to twenty-five grams, which is one hundred to two hundred fifty millilitres. Be able to convert both ways, because a question may give you either one. It works immediately, since it goes straight into the blood. The monograph lists it for suspected or known hypoglycemia, an altered level of responsiveness, and coma or seizure not yet diagnosed. There are no contraindications. The one caution is extravasation, which means the fluid leaks out of the vein into the tissue. D10W can kill that tissue, so check your IV before and during the infusion.
slides.sayZh: D10W 是百分之十的葡萄糖水溶液：每一百毫升含十克糖。BC 剂量是十到二十五克，也就是一百到二百五十毫升。两个方向都要会换算，因为题目可能给你其中任何一个。它直接进入血液，所以立即起效。专论列出的适应症是：疑似或已知低血糖、反应水平改变、原因未明的昏迷或抽搐。没有禁忌症。唯一的注意事项是外渗，也就是液体漏出血管进入周围组织，D10W 会让这些组织坏死，所以输注前和输注中都要检查静脉通路。

slides.title: Diabetic emergencies: EMR vs PCP
slides.body:
Hypoglycemia in BC: BGL < 4.0 mmol/L

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Airway, O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94%; lateral position if needed
  • History, vitals and blood glucose; check for stroke
  • Can protect airway → glucose gel
  • EMR: airway not protected → glucagon

PCP adds

  • Obtain vascular access
  • Confirmed hypoglycemia → D10W 10–25 g
  • Glucagon only if unable to get IV access
  • Transport after the first D10W bolus or glucagon
slides.say: Here's D10W in its protocol. Everything on the left is shared: airway, oxygen, a glucose check, a look for stroke, and glucose gel if the patient can protect their airway. As an EMR, a patient who couldn't protect their airway got glucagon. As a PCP, you start an IV instead, and for confirmed hypoglycemia, meaning your meter shows a reading under four, you give ten to twenty-five grams of D10W. Glucagon is only for when you can't get IV access. Notice the transport cue: you leave after the first bolus of D10W or the glucagon, and keep reassessing on the way.
slides.sayZh: 这是 D10W 所在的流程。左边是共同的：气道、给氧、测血糖、查卒中体征，病人能自护气道就给葡萄糖凝胶。当 EMR 时，不能自护气道的病人给胰高血糖素。当 PCP 时，你改为开静脉；确诊低血糖，也就是血糖仪读数低于四，就给 D10W 十到二十五克。只有开不了静脉时才用胰高血糖素。注意转运时机：第一次推注 D10W 或给完胰高血糖素后就出发，路上继续复评。

slides.q: A known diabetic is confused and can't swallow safely. BGL 2.6 mmol/L. You are the PCP and have a working IV. What do you give?
options: Glucose gel 15 g to the oral mucosa
D10W 10–25 g IV (100–250 mL), then recheck
Glucagon 1 mg IM, because it's faster
slides.say: Quick check. A known diabetic is confused and can't swallow safely. Her blood glucose is two point six. You're the PCP and you have a working IV. What do you give? A, glucose gel, fifteen grams inside the cheek. B, D10W, ten to twenty-five grams IV, which is one hundred to two hundred fifty millilitres, then recheck. C, glucagon one milligram IM, because it's faster. D, D10W, one hundred to two hundred fifty grams IV. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 快速检验。一位已知糖尿病病人意识混乱，不能安全吞咽，血糖二点六。你是 PCP，静脉已开通。给什么？A 葡萄糖凝胶十五克涂在颊内；B D10W 十到二十五克静脉，也就是一百到二百五十毫升，然后复测；C 胰高血糖素一毫克肌注，因为更快；D D10W 一百到二百五十克静脉。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. With a confirmed low sugar and a working IV, the PCP gives D10W, ten to twenty-five grams, and then rechecks. A is wrong because gel is only for a patient who can protect their own airway. C is wrong twice: glucagon is the PCP's backup when there's no IV, and it's slower, taking about fifteen minutes. D mixes up the units: one hundred to two hundred fifty is the volume in millilitres, not the dose in grams.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。确诊低血糖、静脉通畅，PCP 给 D10W 十到二十五克，然后复测。A 错，凝胶只用于能自护气道的病人。C 错两处：胰高血糖素是 PCP 开不了静脉时的备用方案，而且更慢，大约十五分钟起效。D 把单位搞混了：一百到二百五十是毫升数，不是克数。

slides.title: Ondansetron
slides.body:
• Blocks serotonin type 3 (5-HT3) receptors → less nausea
  • For moderate to severe nausea and vomiting
  • Adult 4 mg PO; age 6 months–4 years 2 mg; 4 years and up 4 mg
  • Oral only on the BC exam; onset 15–30 min; lasts more than 5 h
  • No: allergy, congenital long QT, PKU (if using the ODT tablet)
  • First trimester of pregnancy: relative contraindication
slides.say: Ondansetron blocks serotonin type three receptors, which carry the nausea signal to the brain. It's for moderate to severe nausea and vomiting. On the BC licensing exam, it's given by mouth only: four milligrams for an adult, two milligrams for a child from six months to four years, and four milligrams from age four up. It starts working in fifteen to thirty minutes and lasts more than five hours. It's contraindicated with an allergy and with congenital long QT syndrome. The dissolving tablet, called ODT, may contain aspartame, so avoid that form in phenylketonuria, or PKU, where the body can't break down part of that sweetener. The first trimester of pregnancy is a relative contraindication.
slides.sayZh: 昂丹司琼阻断 5-羟色胺三型受体，这类受体把恶心的信号传给大脑。它用于中重度恶心呕吐。在 BC 执照考试里只能口服：成人四毫克；六个月到四岁的孩子两毫克；四岁及以上四毫克。十五到三十分钟起效，持续五小时以上。过敏和先天性长 QT 综合征禁用。口崩片（ODT）可能含阿斯巴甜，所以苯丙酮尿症（PKU）病人不能用这种剂型，因为他们无法分解这种甜味剂里的一部分成分。妊娠头三个月是相对禁忌。

slides.title: Long QT: ask before you give
slides.body:
QT = the heart's electrical recharge time

  • Congenital long QT syndrome: ondansetron is contraindicated
  • Some Indigenous people may have a higher rate of long QT
  • Ask: have you or your family been diagnosed with long QT?
  • If yes → dimenhydrinate is the recommended antiemetic
  • Elderly, liver or kidney disease: watch breathing and alertness
slides.say: The QT interval is part of the ECG. In simple terms, it's the time the heart muscle needs to recharge electrically after each beat. In long QT syndrome that recharge takes too long, which can trigger a dangerous rhythm. People can be born with it, and ondansetron is contraindicated in congenital long QT. The BC monograph adds an important point: some Indigenous people may have a higher rate of long QT because of a genetic variation. So ask Indigenous patients, respectfully, whether they or anyone in their family has been diagnosed with long QT. If so, BC recommends dimenhydrinate instead. Also watch older patients, and those with liver or kidney problems, for slowed breathing or drowsiness.
slides.sayZh: QT 间期是心电图的一部分，简单说，就是心肌每次跳动后在电学上「充电」所需的时间。长 QT 综合征就是这个充电时间太长，可能诱发危险的心律。有人天生就有，先天性长 QT 禁用昂丹司琼。BC 专论特别补充了一点：部分原住民因为基因变异，长 QT 的比例可能更高。所以要礼貌地问原住民病人：你本人或家里有没有人被诊断过长 QT？如果有，BC 推荐改用茶苯海明。另外，老人以及有肝肾问题的病人，要留意呼吸变慢或嗜睡。

slides.title: Dimenhydrinate (Gravol)
slides.body:
• Antiemetic, antihistamine, anticholinergic, anti-vertigo
  • For nausea, vomiting and vertigo; only stop: allergy
  • 1 mg/kg, max 50 mg; looks under 25 kg → contact ER
  • IM: undiluted; onset 20–30 min
  • IV: dilute with NS, push over 1–2 min; works almost at once
  • 50 mg IV: drug + 9 mL NS in a 10 mL syringe, over 2 min
slides.say: Dimenhydrinate, which many patients know as Gravol, is an antihistamine with anticholinergic effects. It calms the balance system in the inner ear, so besides nausea and vomiting, it also treats vertigo, the feeling that the room is spinning. Its only contraindication is allergy. The dose is one milligram per kilogram, up to fifty milligrams, and if the patient looks smaller than twenty-five kilograms, contact the emergency department. Into the muscle, give it undiluted; it works in twenty to thirty minutes. Into the vein, dilute it with normal saline and push slowly. For fifty milligrams, draw the drug into a ten millilitre syringe, add nine millilitres of saline, and give it over two minutes.
slides.sayZh: 茶苯海明，很多病人知道它叫 Gravol，是一种有抗胆碱作用的抗组胺药。它能让内耳的平衡系统安静下来，所以除了恶心呕吐，还能治眩晕，也就是觉得天旋地转。唯一的禁忌是过敏。剂量每公斤一毫克，最多五十毫克；病人看起来不到二十五公斤，要联系急诊。肌注不稀释，二十到三十分钟起效。静脉要用生理盐水稀释、慢推。给五十毫克时，用十毫升注射器抽药，再抽九毫升盐水，两分钟推完。

slides.title: Nausea–vomiting: EMR vs PCP
slides.body:
All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Keep the patient at rest
  • Position of comfort that protects the airway
  • Suction ready; expect more vomiting

PCP adds

  • Consider vascular access
  • Consider dimenhydrinate or ondansetron
  • Hypotension from volume loss → 20 mL/kg, max 2 L
  • Reassess every 500 mL; target systolic 90
  • Stable: antiemetic on scene; unstable: en route
slides.say: Here's the nausea and vomiting protocol. For every licence: rest, a position of comfort that still protects the airway, and suction ready. The PCP adds a lot. Consider an IV, and consider an antiemetic, which is a drug against vomiting: dimenhydrinate or ondansetron. If the patient has lost enough fluid to become hypotensive, give the usual bolus, twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred, and aim for a systolic of ninety. And note the timing rule: a stable patient may get the antiemetic on scene, but an unstable patient gets it en route.
slides.sayZh: 这是恶心呕吐流程。所有执照：让病人休息，摆一个既舒服又能保护气道的体位，吸引器备好。PCP 多做很多：考虑开静脉，考虑用止吐药，也就是茶苯海明或昂丹司琼。如果病人丢失液体多到出现低血压，就按常规推注：每公斤二十毫升、最多两升、每五百毫升复评，目标收缩压九十。还要注意时间规则：稳定的病人可以在现场给止吐药，不稳定的病人在转运途中给。

slides.title: Ondansetron or dimenhydrinate?
slides.body:
OndansetronDimenhydrinate
RoutePO onlyIM, or IV diluted
Doseadult 4 mg1 mg/kg, max 50 mg
Indicationmoderate–severe nausea, vomitingnausea, vomiting, vertigo
Avoid / cautionlong QT, PKU (ODT), first trimesterglaucoma, asthma/COPD, heart disease, enlarged prostate, elderly, pregnancy
Side effectswatch breathing and alertnessdrowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, fast heart
slides.say: So how do you choose? Ondansetron is a tablet, so the patient must be able to take something by mouth, and you must rule out long QT. Dimenhydrinate can go into the muscle or the vein, it also treats vertigo, and it's the recommended choice when long QT is a concern. But dimenhydrinate is anticholinergic, which means it dries secretions and blocks some nerve signals. That's why it needs caution in glaucoma, asthma or COPD, heart disease, an enlarged prostate, older adults and pregnancy. Expect drowsiness, a dry mouth, blurred vision and a faster heart rate. And for ondansetron, the monograph asks you to rate the nausea before, and judge the relief after.
slides.sayZh: 那怎么选？昂丹司琼是片剂，病人要能口服，而且你要先排除长 QT。茶苯海明可以肌注或静脉给，还能治眩晕，有长 QT 顾虑时它是推荐选择。但茶苯海明有抗胆碱作用，意思是会让分泌物变干、阻断部分神经信号，所以青光眼、哮喘或 COPD、心脏病、前列腺增生、老人和孕妇都要慎用。预计会有嗜睡、口干、视物模糊和心跳加快。至于昂丹司琼，专论要求你给药前评估恶心程度，给药后评估缓解效果。

slides.q: An 80 kg Indigenous man is vomiting. His sister has long QT syndrome. He is stable, with a working IV. Which order fits BC?
options: Dimenhydrinate 50 mg, diluted with NS, IV over about 2 minutes
Ondansetron 8 mg PO, a double dose
slides.say: Let's apply it. An eighty-kilogram Indigenous man is vomiting. His sister has been diagnosed with long QT syndrome. He's stable and has a working IV. Which order fits BC? A, ondansetron four milligrams by mouth. B, dimenhydrinate fifty milligrams, diluted with saline, IV over about two minutes. C, dimenhydrinate eighty milligrams IV, one milligram per kilogram. D, ondansetron eight milligrams by mouth, a double dose. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来应用一下。一位八十公斤的原住民男子在呕吐，他姐姐被诊断有长 QT 综合征。他情况稳定，静脉已开通。哪个医嘱符合 BC？A 昂丹司琼四毫克口服；B 茶苯海明五十毫克，用盐水稀释，静脉约两分钟推完；C 茶苯海明八十毫克静脉，按每公斤一毫克；D 昂丹司琼八毫克口服，加倍剂量。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. A family history of long QT in an Indigenous patient is exactly when BC recommends dimenhydrinate instead of ondansetron, so A and D are wrong, and D is also double the BC dose. C forgets the cap: one milligram per kilogram, but never more than fifty milligrams. Given IV, dimenhydrinate is diluted with normal saline and pushed slowly, over one to two minutes.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。原住民病人有长 QT 家族史，正是 BC 推荐用茶苯海明代替昂丹司琼的情况，所以 A 和 D 错，D 还是 BC 剂量的两倍。C 忘了上限：每公斤一毫克，但最多五十毫克。茶苯海明静脉给药要用生理盐水稀释，一到两分钟慢慢推。

slides.title: Diphenhydramine
slides.body:
• Antihistamine: competes with histamine for its receptors
  • Also anticholinergic and sedating
  • For: adjunct treatment of allergic reactions; motion sickness
  • Dose: 25–50 mg IV or 25–50 mg PO
  • No: allergy to antihistamines; neonates
  • Caution: narrow-angle glaucoma, stenosing ulcer; can drop BP
slides.say: Diphenhydramine is an antihistamine. In an allergic reaction, the body releases histamine, which causes hives, itching and leaky blood vessels. Diphenhydramine competes with histamine for its receptors, so it blunts that response. It also has anticholinergic and sedating effects, so patients get sleepy. The BC indication is an adjunct, meaning an add-on, for allergic reactions, and also motion sickness. The dose is twenty-five to fifty milligrams, IV or by mouth. Don't give it to newborns, or to anyone allergic to antihistamines. Use caution with narrow-angle glaucoma and a stenosing, or narrowing, peptic ulcer. And remember that hypotension is a listed adverse effect.
slides.sayZh: 苯海拉明是抗组胺药。过敏反应时身体释放组胺，引起荨麻疹、瘙痒和血管渗漏。苯海拉明和组胺争夺受体，从而削弱这种反应。它还有抗胆碱和镇静作用，病人会犯困。BC 的适应症是过敏反应的辅助治疗，也就是加在主要治疗之上的药，另外还有晕动病。剂量二十五到五十毫克，静脉或口服。新生儿、对抗组胺药过敏的人不能给。闭角型青光眼和狭窄性消化性溃疡要慎用。还要记住，低血压是列出的不良反应之一。

slides.title: Anaphylaxis: EMR vs PCP
slides.body:
All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Supine; don't walk the patient
  • Remove the allergen
  • Airway, O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94%
  • Epinephrine IM
  • Transport; treat en route

PCP adds

  • Still hypotensive → IV, 20 mL/kg (max 2 L), reassess every 500 mL
  • Bronchospasm after epinephrine → salbutamol
  • Diphenhydramine for the medium-term histamine effects
slides.say: Now diphenhydramine in its protocol. Everything that saves the life is on the left, and both licences do it: lay the patient flat and don't let them walk, remove the allergen, support the airway with oxygen, give intramuscular epinephrine, and transport. The PCP adds three things. If the patient stays hypotensive or poorly perfused, start an IV and give fluid boluses. If there's still bronchospasm after the epinephrine, give salbutamol. And give diphenhydramine to limit the histamine response over the medium term. That word, medium-term, is the key. Diphenhydramine is slow and supportive. It never replaces epinephrine, and it never delays it.
slides.sayZh: 再看苯海拉明所在的流程。左边是救命的部分，两种执照都做：让病人平躺、不要让他走动，去除过敏原，气道支持和给氧，肌注肾上腺素，转运。PCP 加三件事：病人持续低血压或灌注不足，就开静脉推注补液；肾上腺素之后还有支气管痉挛，就给沙丁胺醇；再给苯海拉明，限制中期的组胺反应。「中期」这个词是关键：苯海拉明起效慢、是辅助性的，绝不能取代肾上腺素，也绝不能拖延肾上腺素。

slides.title: For the BC exam: book vs BC
slides.body:
• Dextrose: the book uses D50W, D25W or D10W; BC uses D10W only
  • D10W dose in BC: 10–25 g (100–250 mL) IV
  • Ondansetron: the book gives IV, IM or PO; BC gives PO only
  • Child ondansetron: book 0.15 mg/kg; BC 2 mg or 4 mg by age
  • Diphenhydramine adult: book 10–50 mg; BC 25–50 mg
  • Dimenhydrinate has no card in the book, but it's a BC exam drug
slides.say: A few book-versus-BC differences to lock in. Your textbook uses D50, D25 or D10, but BC uses only D10W, ten to twenty-five grams. The book gives ondansetron IV, IM or by mouth; BC gives it by mouth only, and children get a fixed two or four milligrams by age instead of a dose per kilogram. The book's adult diphenhydramine range starts at ten milligrams; BC's is twenty-five to fifty. And dimenhydrinate doesn't have a card in your book's drug list at all, but it's on the BC exam, so learn it from the BC monograph.
slides.sayZh: 几处课本和 BC 的差别要记牢。课本用 D50、D25 或 D10，BC 只用 D10W，十到二十五克。课本的昂丹司琼可以静脉、肌注或口服，BC 只能口服，儿童按年龄固定给两毫克或四毫克，而不是按体重算。课本成人苯海拉明从十毫克起，BC 是二十五到五十毫克。茶苯海明在课本的药物清单里根本没有卡片，但它是 BC 考试药物，要按 BC 专论来学。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• D10W: check the IV first; extravasation kills tissue
  • Grams vs mL: 10–25 g = 100–250 mL
  • Ondansetron: ask about long QT, including family history
  • Dimenhydrinate: max 50 mg; dilute IV and push slowly
  • Both antihistamines cause drowsiness: guard the airway
  • Diphenhydramine is an add-on: epinephrine first, always
slides.say: Here are the new risks. D10W: check that the IV runs well before you push sugar through it, because leaking D10W can kill tissue. And be fluent with grams versus millilitres. Ondansetron: ask about long QT, including the family history, especially with Indigenous patients. Dimenhydrinate: never more than fifty milligrams, and when it goes IV, dilute it and push slowly. Both dimenhydrinate and diphenhydramine can make patients drowsy, and a drowsy patient who is vomiting is an airway risk, so position them and keep suction ready. Finally, diphenhydramine is an add-on. In anaphylaxis, epinephrine always comes first.
slides.sayZh: 新的风险在这里。D10W：推糖之前先确认静脉通畅，因为漏出的 D10W 会让组织坏死；克和毫升的换算要熟练。昂丹司琼：要问长 QT，包括家族史，原住民病人尤其要问。茶苯海明：永远不超过五十毫克，静脉给要稀释、慢推。茶苯海明和苯海拉明都会让病人犯困，一个又困又在呕吐的病人有气道风险，所以要摆好体位、备好吸引器。最后，苯海拉明是辅助药，过敏性休克永远先给肾上腺素。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. D10W 10–25 g (100–250 mL) IV; glucagon only if no IV
  2. Ondansetron 4 mg PO; long QT → dimenhydrinate 1 mg/kg, max 50 mg
  3. Diphenhydramine 25–50 mg IV/PO: after epinephrine, never instead

Next: new PCP drugs: breathing, steroids and TXA
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: D10W, ten to twenty-five grams, which is one hundred to two hundred fifty millilitres IV, for confirmed low sugar, with glucagon only as the backup. Two: ondansetron is four milligrams by mouth for adults, but with long QT, or a family history of it, use dimenhydrinate, one milligram per kilogram up to fifty. Three: diphenhydramine, twenty-five to fifty milligrams IV or by mouth, comes after epinephrine, never instead of it. Next lesson, we finish the new PCP drugs with ipratropium, dexamethasone and TXA. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，D10W 十到二十五克，也就是一百到二百五十毫升静脉，用于确诊低血糖，胰高血糖素只是备用。二，昂丹司琼成人四毫克口服，但有长 QT 或家族史，就改用茶苯海明，每公斤一毫克、最多五十毫克。三，苯海拉明二十五到五十毫克，静脉或口服，放在肾上腺素之后，绝不能代替它。下节课把 PCP 新药讲完：异丙托溴铵、地塞米松和 TXA。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
